rubric: Each scenario names its criterion and says what would make it fail: they pin.

criteria.pins: Does each scenario pin the criterion it names: would it fail if that criterion were not met?
criteria.untestable: Is any criterion written so that no scenario could ever prove it?

reading.why: Each scenario names its criterion and says what would make it fail (the button absent, a row count and prices), so each would fail if its criterion were unmet; both criteria can be proved.
